    }

    return tokenized_train_data

def loss_fn(model, data):
    """
    Perform forward pass on the model and compute loss 
    """
    lm_logits = model(data).logits
    shift_logits = lm_logits[:, :-1, :].contiguous()
    shift_labels = data[:, 1:]

    loss_fct = torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
